method.matching_rule: Bounded planar wall face, centerline bbox 60–63 by 59.5–63 cm, rectangle fill ratio >0.98, at most 6 boundary segments, centroid within source walkway polygon.
method.solid_proxy_caveat: Highlight proxy fills hollow wall loops; physical column dimensions and construction are unverified.
method.completeness_caveat: Detection targets a repeated template; differently sized or connected columns may be excluded. This is not a certified count.
